title: Learning Changes the World and Then What Was Learned Has Changed: Training and Deploying Neural Networks in the Control Loop (Reproduction Suite)
description: Official simulation codes, numerical experiments, and dataset reproduction suite for the paper 'Learning Changes the World and Then What Was Learned Has Changed: Training and Deploying Neural Networks in the Control Loop' by Vittorio Lippi (presented at ICINCO 2026). Includes ensemble Monte Carlo scripts for empirical verification of time-scale separation (Theorem 2), regularized equilibrium shifts, two-phase deployment action error recovery, persistent excitation identifiability trap avoidance, period-doubling bifurcation sweeps, and non-convex neural MLP policy adaptation.
